annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/646 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 as regards uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their emergency lane-keeping systems (ELKS)
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/646 on type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their emergency lane-keeping systems (ELKS)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 133
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation setting uniform type-approval procedures and technical specifications for emergency lane-keeping systems (driver assistance) in passenger cars and light commercial vehicles, including test procedures, a safety audit of electronic control systems, and certificate templates. Applies from 6 July 2022.
key_provisions_or_claims: ELKS must comprise a lane departure warning system and a corrective directional control function.
Specifies speed ranges, warning modalities, and a steering override force limit of 50 N.
Defines vehicle tests for LDWS and CDCF performance.
Annex II safety audit requires documentation of fault strategy, hazard analysis and validation for electronic control systems.
Applies from 6 July 2022, binding in its entirety in all Member States.
